column5: SceneObject slots 27-2E 35 37 (frames, play, stopAndRedraw(Dc), tick incl. Crossbow's and Target's, stop, getTimerId, isRunning), AnimationVtbl playOnce, animation_set_strip
the WinG shell: WinMain, app_init, AppWndProc (create, destroy, activate, paint wave, 0x40b hello / 0x40c ready), message loop
the crossbow's aim and the arrow: creation, ProjectileVtbl stepMove/tryStep (the first hit stage), the shot wave
Backdrop/GridBackdrop (one WinG bitmap), TiroBackdrop's create (the wall cells), the occupancy grid and its queries
DIB loading, copies and the row blitters (1000 is NOITE's byte-identical 32-bit segment)
TiroScene: its handler (keys, the target and arrow timers, the second hit stage, the end test, WM_DESTROY and 0x40a; BUGS.md T1-T5), create (MCI, WaveMix, the score), createScreen
TiroGame: ctor/dtor, GameVtbl 01-06 (createPlayer: the crossbow and its 16 arrows, panel, status bar, init scene, onCreate), game_init, game_take_exit, the conditions
game_handle_message (GameVtbl 00, 3.7 KB: the engine default under the TIRO handler, which takes every input) and the Portable pick-up/drop it calls
ObjectList, DrawList, UpdateList (out of line in TIRO) and message_box_printf (the shared g_messageText)
SceneObject slots 2F-34 36 (moveTo, edges, stopMoving(Dc) incl. Target's/Projectile's, moveTick, isMoving) and MoverVtbl/TargetVtbl/ProjectileVtbl placeAt
constructors and destructors of the objects (Crossbow/Target/Arrow/Projectile, Player2D/Actor2D/Mover/Animation, TiroPanel/ControlPanel/Animated3D/Object3D, StatusBar, SceneObject) and frames
SceneObject slots 22-26 (occupy, vacate, attach, canStep incl. Target's, isStepBlocked) and reattach
the ControlPanel/TiroPanel and StatusBar methods (ControlPanelVtbl 01-08), draw, tick, inventory icons; created and attached, never shown
SceneObject slots 08-0C getX/getY/getStep, 39 setPosition, 4C unk4E, 4E/4F overlap tests, 50/51 54/55 defaults; the /Od out-of-line accessors (hit box, frame, size); next_object_id
SceneObject slots 12-1A (dirty rects, overlap, restore background incl. Target's (BUGS.md T6), drawDirtyTo, draw, drawClip(To), erase, slot1F) and the DC hooks
Scene methods (SceneVtbl 01-04 06 08-0C), ctors, scene_create and the destructor, exits
WaveMix (the five TIRO waves)
SceneObject slots 00-07 0D-11 38 (Object3D getters/setters, drawBounds), the Object3DVtbl slots, the perspective math
the targets: creation, TargetVtbl checkEdge (the wrap), hit (+150 girl / -150 traveco), respawn, the score box
SceneObject slots 1B-21 (redraw, hideAndInvalidate, blitToDc, invalidate, slot24, hide, show) and 4D redrawOverlapping (Target's, Projectile's)
